short.en: Start anywhere on the top row

t.zh: 现在图有好几列。缝从顶行任意一个像素出发，每一步走到正下方、左下方或右下方的像素，一直走到底行。
t.en: Now the picture has several columns. A seam starts at any pixel of the top row, and each step goes to the pixel right below, below-left or below-right, all the way to the bottom row.

goal.zh: 能量最低的那条缝，能量是多少？答案是底行里最小的数。
goal.en: What is the energy of the lowest-energy seam? The answer is the smallest number in the bottom row.

how.en: Row by row, from the top down.

say.zh: 缝每一步可以往左下、正下、右下走：上一行的左上、正上、右上都是来路。
say.en: Each step of a seam may go below-left, straight down or below-right: up-left, up and up-right on the row above are all ways in.

hints.zh: 到这一格之前，缝在上一行的哪几个像素上？
hints.en: Before reaching this cell, which pixels of the row above could the seam be on?

hints.zh: 挑能量最低的那一个，再加上这一格自己的能量。
hints.en: Pick the lowest of them, then add this cell’s own energy.

solution: c = min(view.ul, view.up, facts.top, facts.energy, view.ur)

body.zh: 和<level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref>是同一副骨架：取较小，再加上本格。只是来路从两条变成了上一行的三条，起点从一格变成了整个顶行。
body.en: The same skeleton as <level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref>: take the min, then add this cell. Only the ways in grew from two to three on the row above, and the start from one cell to the whole top row.
